style_baseline_character: PURE BLACK INK SILHOUETTE cartoon character, solid black filled body with simple line details inside, NO COLOR FILL except solid black, drawn on transparent background PNG, like a comic strip ink drawing, very simple geometric shapes, 1980s LCD game character art, no shading gradient, no realistic rendering, single subject centered, no text, no border, no shadow on ground
style_baseline_background: hand-drawn cartoon western saloon interior in 45-degree perspective view (semi-overhead, looking into the saloon room). Bold black ink outlines on cream/beige paper background. Flat color blocks only — soft pastel accents (dusty pink bar counter, light blue shelf background, pale yellow walls). NO realistic lighting, NO gradient shading, NO photo realism. Wide 16:9 aspect. Composition has clear depth: left side wall (with swinging double doors as the entrance from outside), back wall (with WANTED poster, SALOON sign, bottle shelves), middle ground with round saloon tables and chairs, foreground empty wooden plank floor with perspective lines toward back. NO characters, NO floating text, looks like a vintage hand-drawn comic page
style_baseline_ui: hand-drawn cartoon style, western billboard typography, bold black ink outline, simple flat fill in gold or cream, transparent background PNG
style_baseline_item: PURE BLACK INK cartoon icon, solid black silhouette with thin white interior lines for detail, drawn like a 1980s comic strip, on transparent background PNG, single object centered, NO color fill except black, NO shadow, NO decoration
